image_description: A Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) is partially visible, hiding within a rocky crevice or coral structure. The anterior portion of the fish, including the head and part of the body, is black with a distinct yellow patch on the operculum/shoulder area. The posterior golden-yellow body and tail are largely occluded by the rock overhang. The environment appears to be an underwater reef scene with purple and pinkish rocky textures.
